title: A Garden for the Hollow Anew
author: Freya Yarrow
blurb: Yara Nystrom, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
